title: Jamaican Leek Stew
description: A flavorful and hearty stew made with Jamaican spices, aromatic vegetables, and tender leeks.
instructions: Heat oil over medium heat in a large pot.
Add the sliced aromatic and sauté until softened.
Add the sliced leek and cook until tender.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the Jamaican stew seasoning and stir to combine.
Pour in enough water to cover the vegetables and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
